atomic_claims.text: The /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41.0/day (window ending 2026-08-17) to 22.0/day (window starting 2026-08-18).
Over 28 days the /bueroreinigung page received 293 impressions across three pricing/quote-intent queries it does not answer on-page.
Sibling PSS service pages that carry a pricing/quote H2 achieved 4.2% mean CTR for equivalent-intent queries versus 0.79% for the /bueroreinigung gap queries.

public_evidence.method: mean of the seven daily values in each window
sum impressions over the three gap queries; read the current on-page H2 list
mean CTR over three sibling pages that carry a pricing/quote H2

pss_data.implementation_constraint: one operator; static site; on-page edits reversible by reverting one commit

test_plan.hypothesis: Adding three original H2 sections to /bueroreinigung that answer the three named pricing/quote-intent queries raises the combined CTR for those exact queries toward the 4.2% sibling-page benchmark, without worsening the top-query position.
test_plan.baseline: 28-day impression-weighted CTR for the three gap queries = 0.79% across 293 impressions; top-query average position 8.9.
test_plan.change: Add three original H2 sections answering the three named queries; no other page touched.
test_plan.kpi: 28-day CTR for the three named queries on /bueroreinigung
test_plan.period: 8 weeks after the change versus the prior 8 weeks
test_plan.success_threshold: combined CTR for the three named queries reaches at least 2.5% with top-query average position no worse than 9.5
test_plan.stop_threshold: top-query average position worse than 12 for two consecutive weeks, or total page clicks fall a further 15%
test_plan.observation_window: 8 weeks with an interim read at week 4

rationale: This is clearly the strongest quick win on the board right now and we should not let it sit; every week we wait is quote requests walking to a competitor. The Verifier only needs to confirm the impression counts and the sibling benchmark and then we ship.
